# Wildflower Studio
> Creative production and practical AI automation studio based in Cape Town, South Africa.

Wildflower Studio helps growing businesses eliminate repetitive admin and elevate their visual brand presence.

## Core Services
- **24/7 WhatsApp & Website AI Assistants**: Custom digital assistants trained on a business's pricing, availability, and FAQs to reply to leads and book appointments automatically.
- **Admin & Quote Automation**: Hands-free PDF quote generation, client onboarding, and invoice reminders.
- **Website Design & Engineering**: High-converting, mobile-first editorial websites connected to automated lead capture.
- **Commercial Video Ads & Photography**: Short-form video ads, e-commerce catalog photography, and monthly social content.

## Contact & Booking
